description: This file implements a TCP socket server class 'SocketServer' with methods for opening, running, accepting connections, sending and receiving messages, and handling responses. It also defines related data structures and enums for socket communication, including command IDs and message headers.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message with a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server with methods to manage connections, send/receive messages, and handle communication.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes and starts the server socket, binds to an address and port, and begins listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server's main loop.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main server loop that accepts client connections and processes incoming responses.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the server and client sockets, stopping the server.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket, handling partial reads.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with channel ID, token, and JSON payload to the client.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach command with channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to terminate the client connection.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response message from the client, parsing the header and JSON payload.
